لَبِيجٌ A man, or a camel, falling, or fallen, down upon the ground by reason of disease or fatigue. (TA.) ―
-b2- بَرْكٌ لَبِيجٌ Camels laying on their breasts with folded legs around a tent: (K:) or all the camels of the tribe so lying around the tents, as though thrown down upon the ground. (S.) ―
-b3- لَبِيجٌ Remaining, staying, abiding, or dwelling. (AHn.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
